fusions.name: Horned Crown
fusions.desc: A heavy chop that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Shoulder Check
fusions.desc: A shove behind the swing that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocks them back 1.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Planted Hooves
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Stubborn Tally
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 4% more damage per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
